Admin routes of the tax module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/tax/classes

List tax classes

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `zoneId` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Classes retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/tax/classes

Create tax class

Request body: [CreateTaxClassAdminDto](#createtaxclassadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: Class created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## GET /v1/admin/tax/zones

List tax zones

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Zones retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/tax/zones

Create tax zone

Request body: [CreateTaxZoneAdminDto](#createtaxzoneadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: Zone created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## GET /v1/admin/tax/zones/{id}

Get tax zone

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Zone retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Zone not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/tax/zones/{id}

Update tax zone

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateTaxZoneAdminDto](#updatetaxzoneadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Zone updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Zone not found.
